Job Description – Practice Nurse
Job title: Practice Nurse	Reports to: Head Nurse 
                        Chief Executive Officer
Purpose of position
To ensure smooth and efficient functioning of the practice and provide an exceptional standard of care to our patients.

Responsibilities 

Clinical
•	Perform clinical duties within required level of clinical competency, according to best available evidence.  Explain procedures to patients, providing them with support and reassurance.  Duties include triage, immunisations and other injections; wound management, chronic disease management, ECG’s and collection of pathology samples.  Assist doctors with clinical procedures.  Maintain clinical documentation.
•	Oversee cold chain process, awareness, responsibilities and documentation of cold chain process.
•	Monitor infection control standards and implement changes / educate.

Patient Services
•	Assist with triage, data management, diagnostic services, networking with other providers, planning & management of patient care and patient advocacy.  Telephone patients with test results as directed by medical staff.  

Improvement of Patient Health Outcomes
•	Conduct preventative/screening procedures; assist with patient education and community health promotion activities.  Co-ordinate patient recall and outreach programs and GP management plans and team care arrangement.  

Equipment and Supplies
•	Maintain stocks of clinical supplies, including correct storage (such as refrigeration), removal of out-of-date stock and ordering supplies.  Provide input in purchasing relevant clinical equipment and supplies.
•	Assist with stock ordering bi – monthly
•	Assist with monthly vaccine order
•	Complete daily job allocation sheet
•	Check emergency trolley daily
•	Check O2 therapy as per job description
•	Monitor cold chain process twice daily

Compliance
•	Maintain awareness of current and new legislation to ensure business is complying with all statutory and regulatory obligations including infection control, sterilisation, hazardous materials & safe handling/disposal of medical waste, records management, OHS, and accreditation.  Ensure relevant personnel are kept informed and changes are made to systems and procedures as required.  

Professional
•	Act within the practice and nursing code of ethics & appropriate level of clinical competence at all times.  Maintain awareness of current evidence and research on clinical practices and inform/educate other practice staff. Change systems and procedures to ensure compliance with best available evidence as applicable.  

OHS
•	Consistently be aware of OHS requirements and comply with them.

General
Delegation of tasks to other medical and non-medical staff. 
Assist with other practice duties as required.  

Expected behaviours and personal attributes 
•	Demonstrate a knowledge of and compliance with all relevant legislation and common law obligations affecting nursing.
•	Discharge of duty of care in the course of practice including meeting practice standards, and accountability for nursing actions.
•	Demonstrate knowledge of policies and procedural guidelines that have legal implications, for example, ensure documentation conforms to legal requirements.
•	Practice only within the limits of their educational preparation and competence.
•	Identify and respond to unsafe practice, for example, implement interventions to prevent unsafe practice and/or contravention of law.
•	Demonstrated patient-focused approach in service provision with genuine empathy and interest in their needs.
•	Excellent interpersonal and communication skills across all ages and social groups.
•	Be always well presented, friendly, courteous and obliging.  Represent the practice in a confident and positive manner at all times. 
•	Undertake all duties in a diligent manner, with honesty and integrity, 
•	Maintain absolute confidentiality regarding patient and practice information.
•	Have a vigilant attitude to accuracy, being prepared to double check as necessary.
•	Ability to work cooperatively and independently. & ability to prioritise and organise, with attention to detail.
•	Demonstrated commitment to ongoing professional development
•	This position requires physical ability to occasionally lift and/or move patients.
•	Possession of current driver’s licence (include only if essential to perform job, such as home visits)

Education, Qualifications and Experience  
Essential:
•	Appropriate tertiary qualification & registration certificate. 
•	Professional indemnity cover.
•	Minimum of one year of nursing experience, preferably in a community-based role.
•	Demonstrated understanding of the needs of general practice and interest in community-based nursing including patient education and health promotion.
•	Knowledge of current immunisation schedules, Diabetes management, asthma management, enhanced primary care items, infection control, CPR and emergency resuscitation techniques, equipment & drugs.

Desirable:
•	Competence in the use of relevant equipment & software – be specific, give brand-names if appropriate. 
•	Experience in similar role as practice nurse or community-based nursing.
•	Experience with specific social groups serviced by practice, such as adolescents, aged care, migrant or refuge groups, aboriginals & Torres Straight islanders, etc.
•	Additional qualifications such as Accredited Women’s Health Certificate, Diabetes Education Certificate, Asthma/Spirometry qualification/education.
•	Member of APNA.

Hours Of Work
As per fortnightly roster 
Weekend & Public Holiday work as rostered   
However it is expected that our staff will work extra time on occasions if this is required to deliver essential patient care.
Breaks:  30 minutes for lunch and 10 minutes each for morning and afternoon tea to be taken in shifts with other staff to ensure continuity of care. 

Other features: 
 
Professional development provided or expected.
Requirement for use of own vehicle, if essential to the position.
Potential for contact with hazardous material such as blood & body fluids.
May be required to have some immunisations.

Boston Scientific
Clinical Specialist - Electrophysiology
Queensland
$85,000+

ABOUT THE ROLE

Our elite sales team is made up of passionate, dedicated professionals, delivering the most advanced medical technologies to patients in need. By collaborating extensively with leading healthcare professionals you’ll see first-hand the impact you have on individual lives - one patient at a time. 

The position of Clinical Specialist, Electrophysiology (EP), provides field/remote clinical, technical & educational support in EP to assigned accounts across ANZ. The primary focus is to support new therapy introduction of Pulsed Field Ablation through our recent launch of the FARAPULSE™ system, demonstrating clinical expertise to influence superior outcomes. Frequent travel will be required as part of the role. 

The Clinical Specialist – Electrophysiology role is based in Queensland and reports to the Field Clinical Specialist Manager.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

•	Utilising your technical knowledge of:
o	The field of electrophysiology (including propagation of electrical circuits within cardiac tissue and the pathophysiology of electrical rhythm disorders), biophysics of radiofrequency, cryo-thermal ablation, 2D and 3D electroanatomical mapping principles to provide:
?	Clinical support including basic trouble-shooting, and clinical guidance to diagnose and treat cardiac arrhythmias
?	Provide the measurement of electrical circuits within the heart and perform stimulation protocols as per physician requests to measure the electrical conductivity of the heart to aid in the diagnosis of cardiac arrhythmias
?	Develop a deep technical understanding of, and provide the technical training of company products to Cardiac Electrophysiologists, Cardiac Physiologists and Nurses
•	Travelling as required to meet customer demand for the services described above.
•	Attending cases face to face (or remotely) with customers, operating Boston Scientific products where appropriate, and providing detailed training / advice to physicians on clinical attributes / techniques associated with Boston Scientific electrophysiology products including:
o	Providing clinical support for: FARAPULSE™, OPAL™, RHYTHMIA™, LAB SYSTEM PRO™, MAESTRO 4000™, METRIQ™, plus support for the full range of Boston Scientific EP Catheters

## Position Overview

- Experience with SEO best practices and web accessibility standards such as WCAG 2.1
- Exposure to cloud-based hosting platforms including AWS, Google Cloud, or Microsoft Azure
- Experience working within agile or collaborative project delivery environments
- Familiarity with web performance optimisation techniques, including caching strategies and content delivery networks (CDNs)
## Why Join Us?

About UniFresh

UniFresh Processors Pty Ltd is a leading Australian fresh produce processor and distributor supplying premium fresh-cut vegetables throughout Western Australia, South Australia, the Northern Territory and New South Wales. We are committed to delivering safe, high-quality fresh produce by maintaining rigorous food safety, quality assurance and production standards throughout our supply chain. As our Western Australian operations continue to grow, we are seeking an experienced Primary Products Quality Assurance Officer to join our processing team.

About the Role - Primary Products Quality Assurance Officer 

Reporting to the WA Operations Manager, you will play an important role in maintaining UniFresh's quality assurance program across all stages of receiving, processing, packing and dispatch of fresh vegetables. Working closely with local suppliers and production staff, you will ensure products consistently meet customer specifications, food safety requirements and company quality standards.

Why Join UniFresh?
- Permanent full-time position.
- Competitive salary package.
- Supportive and collaborative working environment.
- Opportunity to contribute to the growth of a leading Australian fresh produce processor.
- Ongoing professional development opportunities.

The typical job responsibilities will include, but are not limited to the following:

- Monitor and implement quality assurance procedures throughout receiving, washing, cutting, packing, storage and dispatch operations.
- Inspect incoming fresh vegetables to verify compliance with company quality standards and customer specifications before production.
- Assess fresh produce for quality, freshness, maturity, grading, defects, spoilage, contamination and foreign matter.
- Collect product samples and perform routine quality checks during processing to verify compliance with food safety and customer requirements.
- Monitor hygiene, sanitation and Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) throughout production and packing operations.
- Maintain accurate quality assurance documentation, inspection records, product testing results and non-conformance reports.
- Investigate quality issues, identify root causes and assist in implementing corrective and preventative actions.
- Conduct supplier quality assessments and participate in supplier visits to verify compliance with UniFresh's quality and food safety requirements.
- Provide guidance to suppliers and production staff regarding product quality, grading standards, handling procedures and continuous quality improvement.
- Participate in internal quality audits, customer audits and verification activities to ensure compliance with HACCP, food safety and company quality management systems.
- Verify finished products are correctly graded, packed, labelled and stored prior to dispatch.
- Support continuous improvement initiatives to enhance product quality, reduce waste and improve operational efficiency.

Applicants must meet the following minimum requirements to be considered for the role:

- Bachelor’s degree in food science, Food Technology, Agriculture, Horticulture or a related discipline.
- At least one year of relevant experience in quality assurance, food production, fresh produce processing or a similar food manufacturing environment.
- Demonstrated knowledge of HACCP, Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP), food safety legislation and quality assurance systems.
- Experience conducting product inspections, quality verification and quality assessments within a food processing or fresh produce environment.
- Ability to monitor quality assurance procedures and maintain accurate quality records and documentation.
- Strong attention to detail with excellent analytical, organizational and problem-solving skills.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work collaboratively with suppliers, production teams and other stakeholders.
- Current Australian Driver License.

Four Seasons is powered by our people. We are a collective of individuals who crave to become better, to push ourselves to new heights and to treat each other as we wish to be treated in return. Our team members around the world create amazing experiences for our guests, residents, and partners through a commitment to luxury with genuine heart. We know that the best way to enable our people to deliver these exceptional guest experiences is through a world-class employee experience and company culture.         

At Four Seasons, we believe in recognizing a familiar face, welcoming a new one and treating everyone we meet the way we would want to be treated ourselves. Whether you work with us, stay with us, live with us or discover with us, we believe our purpose is to create impressions that will stay with you for a lifetime. It comes from our belief that life is richer when we truly connect to the people and the world around us.



About the location:

When you think about Four Seasons, we hope unparalleled luxury comes to mind. But what is luxury, really? Our answer may surprise you. To us, true luxury is a meaningful sense of belonging. It is a dedicated focus on how people want to be treated, grounded in the genuine care you experience during your stay and defined by an abundance of humanity and generosity. This starts with our passionate team, welcoming you to be the centre of our world, anywhere in the world – and always with a distinctly human touch. The views are just the beginning at Four Seasons Hotel Sydney, located at the epicentre of the historic Rocks district, sparkling Harbour and buzzing CBD. Chic rooms and suites embrace the iconic attractions just steps away, while the award-winning restaurant and street front bar are destinations unto themselves.



About the Role of Director of Public Relations & Marketing:

Reporting to the Regional Commercial Director, the Director of Public Relations & Marketing is responsible for the development and execution of an annual strategic and integrated plan that is comprised of public relations, social media and marketing communications strategies that support the hotel’s business objectives, increase awareness and positive perception of the hotel and its Food & Beverage outlets, and contribute to driving traffic and revenues.

To thrive in this role, the ideal candidate will have an eye for detail, an ear for a great story, a thirst for multi-tasking and a hunger for results, working independently or in collaboration, to meet tight deadlines whilst managing multiple projects simultaneously. The ideal candidate will have solid and long lasting media and influencer relationships across the travel, lifestyle and tourism industries and be able to deliver robust PR & Communications strategies for a market leading luxury brand.



What you will do:

- Develop and execute a strategic plan including PR, social media and other marketing communications channels to support the business objectives of the hotel
- Deploy a creative content strategy across multiple owned and earned channels which presents relevant and engaging content and increases follower engagement
- Manage the hotel’s digital content strategy including the website, APP, OTA’s and social media channels, by setting metrics, monitoring results and tracking ROI
- Manage imagery and branding elements for the hotel including coordination of photography, videography, imagery, print collateral and publications
- Engage in media and influencer relations by actively managing professional relationships with local and regional media, by hosting media visits, building partnerships, pitching targeted story ideas, organising fam trips and photo shoots, entertaining key contacts
- Manage the internal and external communications strategy, handle incoming media enquiries and support social PR activities
- Work closely with operational departments and the senior leadership team on marketing and promotional strategies, budgets and communications



What you will bring:

- 5+ years' experience in a senior PR & communications leadership role within the hotel/travel/tourism industry or within a luxury brand
- A leadership style that is authentic, engaging and strategic, based on identified business priorities and capable of mentoring and driving team success
- Skilled storytelling and content creation that is aligned with and enhances the Sales & Marketing strategy
- Impeccable communication, negotiation and influencing skills
- Sense of style and aesthetics, with a sharp attention to detail
- A self-starter with strong project management skills and the ability to organise, prioritise and delegate in a fast paced environment
- Desire to transform the execution of PR and maximize impact of relationships and activations
- Proficiency in leveraging social media networks and related monitoring tools
- The ability to create newsworthy events, develop story ideas and follow through with pitch leads
- Tertiary Qualifications in communications/journalism/public relations/ marketing highly regarded



What we offer:

- Competitive Salary, wages, and a comprehensive benefits package
- Excellent Training and Development opportunities
- Complimentary Accommodation at other Four Seasons Hotels and Resorts
- Complimentary Dry Cleaning for Employee Uniforms
- Complimentary Employee Meals



If you feel this is the role for you we would love to hear from you!


We make it a point to take the time to review each resume carefully to select those that are a match with the preferred qualifications for the job. If that’s you, we will contact you to set up a time to get to know each other.

## Cyber Security Operations Coordinator
## Position Overview
We are looking for a skilled and proactive Cyber Security Operations Coordinator to lead the coordination and response to complex cyber security incidents, threat hunting investigations, and cross-functional security operations. This role plays a critical part in safeguarding organisational systems and data by driving incident response activities, advising leadership on operational matters, and contributing to strategic security planning. The ideal candidate is a technically proficient security professional with strong coordination capabilities, sound analytical judgement, and the ability to communicate complex security issues clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
## Key Responsibilities
- Lead the end-to-end investigation and response to cyber security incidents, including containment, mitigation, and recovery activities, ensuring timely resolution and minimal operational disruption
- Direct threat hunting operations to proactively identify threat vectors, develop threat models, and build security cases that inform defensive strategies across the organisation
- Analyse security risks, vulnerabilities, and emerging threats, translating findings into actionable security plans and technical controls aligned with the organisation's security architecture
- Coordinate and manage tasks across multiple teams during incident response and threat hunt engagements, ensuring clear communication, accountability, and effective workflow throughout each operation
- Advise senior leadership on the status of current security operations, ongoing collaborations, and key findings, contributing meaningfully to strategic security planning and policy development
- Develop and communicate key messaging around security incidents and threat intelligence, ensuring accurate and timely information is delivered to the appropriate stakeholders
- Oversee the collection, preservation, and forensic analysis of digital evidence in accordance with established procedures and chain-of-custody requirements
- Implement and maintain technical security controls that align with the organisation's security strategies, frameworks, and compliance obligations
- Perform ongoing threat management activities, monitoring threat landscapes and updating security models to reflect evolving attack techniques and adversary behaviours
- Facilitate and coordinate security awareness training programmes for staff, promoting a security-conscious culture across the organisation
- Maintain detailed records of incident response activities, investigation findings, and operational outcomes to support continuous improvement and audit readiness
- Collaborate with internal teams and external partners to uphold the integrity, confidentiality, and availability of organisational systems and information assets
## Required Qualifications & Skills
- Bachelor's degree in Cyber Security, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience
- Demonstrated experience in a cyber security operations, incident response, or threat intelligence role, with exposure to coordinating cross-functional teams
- Strong working knowledge of incident response methodologies, threat hunting techniques, and digital forensics processes
- Experience conducting security risk assessments, vulnerability analyses, and developing actionable remediation plans
- Proficiency with security tools and platforms such as SIEM, EDR, IDS/IPS, and threat intelligence feeds
- Solid understanding of security frameworks and standards, including NIST, ISO 27001, or the Australian Cyber Security Centre (ACSC) Essential Eight
- Demonstrated ability to analyse and interpret complex technical information and communicate findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences
- Strong project coordination and task management skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities in a high-pressure environment
- Sound understanding of network security, endpoint protection, identity and access management, and cloud security principles
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with experience producing professional reports, briefings, and incident documentation
## Preferred Qualifications
- Industry certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CEH, GIAC (e.g. GCIH, GCFA), or CompTIA Security+
- Experience working within a Security Operations Centre (SOC) environment or managed security services setting
- Familiarity with Australian regulatory and compliance requirements, including the Privacy Act, Notifiable Data Breaches scheme, and relevant sector-specific obligations
- Exposure to threat intelligence platforms, malware analysis, or reverse engineering
- Experience contributing to the development of security policies, procedures, or organisational security awareness programmes
- Prior experience briefing or advising senior leadership or executive stakeholders on cyber security matters
## Why Join Us?
- Be part of a collaborative and forward-thinking security team where your contributions directly shape the organisation's cyber resilience
- Access ongoing professional development opportunities, including support for industry certifications, training programmes, and conference attendance
- Enjoy a flexible working environment that supports work-life balance, including hybrid work arrangements
- Competitive remuneration package with superannuation, reflective of your skills and experience
- Work within a values-driven organisation committed to innovation, integrity, and building a diverse and inclusive workplace
## Job Details
- Job Type: Full-time, Permanent
- Work Schedule: 8-hour shift
- Salary: $70,000 – $120,000 per year + Superannuation

Retail Manager 

Business: FLIP OUT Gladesville
Address:  Gladesville NSW 2111
Employment Type: Full-time, Ongoing
Salary: AUD $75,000 – $85,000 per annum plus superannuation

About the Business

FLIP OUT Gladesville operates as a leading indoor family entertainment and recreation centre within Australia's FLIP OUT network, providing customers with a safe, engaging, and high-quality leisure experience. The business offers a wide range of attractions and services, including trampoline activities, children's birthday parties, group bookings, school holiday programs, corporate events, café services, and general recreational activities for individuals and families.
Committed to exceptional customer experiences, safety, and operational excellence, FLIP OUT Gladesville maintains high standards across customer service delivery, workforce management, venue operations, and regulatory compliance. The business serves a diverse customer base comprising families, schools, community groups, and corporate clients, operating within a fast-paced and customer-focused environment that requires effective operational leadership and efficient coordination of multiple service offerings.
Position Overview
The Retail Manager is responsible for the end-to-end management of FLIP OUT Gladesville's daily operations, ensuring efficient venue performance, exceptional customer service, strong financial outcomes, and effective workforce leadership. The role requires hands-on operational involvement within a dynamic entertainment and hospitality environment and accountability for workforce management, customer experience, venue operations, inventory control, and compliance with all applicable workplace health and safety requirements.
This is a senior operational role suited to an experienced retail, hospitality, or leisure operations professional who thrives in a structured, customer-focused, and performance-driven environment and possesses strong leadership, organisational, and problem-solving capabilities.
 
Key Responsibilities
Venue Operations & Performance
•	Plan, coordinate, and manage the daily operations of the venue to achieve customer service, productivity, and business performance targets.
•	Ensure compliance with all workplace health and safety obligations, operational procedures, and venue safety standards.
•	Monitor key operational performance indicators including labour costs, revenue performance, customer satisfaction outcomes, and operational efficiency.
•	Coordinate venue workflows during peak trading periods, school holidays, party bookings, and special events to maintain service excellence.
•	Identify opportunities to improve operational processes, customer experiences, and service delivery standards.
•	Oversee opening and closing procedures and ensure the venue is maintained to the highest operational standards.
People Leadership & Team Management
•	Recruit, train, roster, supervise, and motivate venue employees including customer service staff, party hosts, café attendants, supervisors, and operational team members.
•	Provide ongoing coaching, performance management, and staff development consistent with business objectives and operational expectations.
•	Foster a positive and collaborative workplace culture that promotes teamwork, accountability, customer service excellence, and operational efficiency.
•	Monitor employee performance and ensure adequate staffing levels are maintained throughout trading hours and special events.
•	Promote compliance with workplace policies and ensure adherence to employment obligations and organisational standards.
Customer Experience & Service Delivery
•	Oversee customer service delivery across general admissions, birthday parties, group bookings, school programs, and café operations.
•	Resolve customer complaints and service issues promptly and professionally to maintain customer satisfaction and business reputation.
•	Maintain high standards of venue presentation, cleanliness, safety, and customer engagement at all times.
•	Coordinate customer bookings and ensure scheduled activities are delivered efficiently and in accordance with operational requirements.
•	Support customer service initiatives aimed at enhancing the overall visitor experience and encouraging repeat patronage.
Inventory Management & Cost Control
•	Manage inventory levels relating to café supplies, merchandise, operational consumables, and venue requirements.
•	Conduct regular stocktakes and monitor inventory usage, wastage levels, and operational expenditure.
•	Implement effective cost control measures to support profitability objectives and operational efficiency.
•	Ensure venue equipment, POS systems, and operational assets are maintained and functioning efficiently.
•	Coordinate with suppliers, contractors, and support service providers regarding operational requirements when necessary.
Compliance & Administration
•	Ensure compliance with workplace health and safety legislation, food safety requirements applicable to café operations, and internal operational policies and procedures.
•	Prepare operational reports, sales summaries, labour reports, booking reports, and performance documentation as required.
•	Maintain accurate records relating to staffing, inventory management, customer bookings, and operational performance.
•	Implement and monitor company policies, procedures, and operational guidelines across all aspects of venue management.
•	Support ongoing compliance audits, venue inspections, and operational assessments where required.
 
Skills & Experience

Essential Requirements
•	Proven experience in retail, hospitality, entertainment, or leisure operations management within a fast-paced operational environment.
•	Demonstrated leadership capability with experience managing teams, employee rostering, and operational workflows.
•	Strong understanding of inventory management, cost control principles, and customer service management.
•	Excellent organisational, communication, and problem-solving skills.
•	Ability to work effectively under pressure while maintaining high service and safety standards.
•	Flexibility to work evenings, weekends, school holidays, and public holidays as required by operational needs.
•	Preference will be given to suitably qualified Australian Citizens and Permanent Residents.

Preferred Qualifications
•	AQF Associate Degree, Advanced Diploma or Diploma (ANZSCO Skill Level 2); or
•	At least three years of relevant experience may substitute for the formal qualifications listed above. In some instances, relevant experience and/or on-the-job training may be required in addition to formal qualifications.
•	Previous experience within family entertainment, hospitality, retail, or customer-focused service industries will be highly regarded.
•	Current Food Safety Certification and First Aid qualifications or willingness to obtain are desirable.
•	Experience using point-of-sale systems, workforce management tools, and booking management systems will be highly regarded.
 
Work Environment
The Retail Manager role is highly operational and requires active participation on the venue floor alongside employees throughout daily operations. The position demands excellent time management skills, resilience under pressure, strong leadership capabilities, and the ability to manage multiple operational priorities simultaneously within a high-volume customer service environment. The successful candidate will be expected to lead by example, maintain operational excellence, uphold customer safety standards, and contribute positively to the ongoing success and growth of FLIP OUT Gladesville.

Provide high-quality specialist dermatology services to inpatients, outpatients and referred patients of St Vincent's Hospital Sydney.

The Visiting Medical Officer - Dermatology provides specialist dermatology services to patients of St Vincent's Hospital Sydney across inpatient, outpatient and consultation settings. The position is responsible for the assessment, diagnosis and management of a broad range of dermatological disorders and contributes to the delivery of high-quality, evidence-based and patient-centred care.

Mo's Mobiles is a proudly Australian owned and operated telecommunications retailer and an exclusive partner of Vodafone. Vodafone company has grown to a network of more than 50 stores across the country, helping everyday Australians and small businesses stay connected with the latest smartphones, mobile broadband and NBN devices, and the full range of Vodafone plans. Everything we do comes back to a simple idea: give every customer an exceptional in-store experience and great value on every visit. Our Springfield store, located in the heart of Orion Springfield Central, serves one of South East Queensland's fastest growing communities. We are now looking for a capable and energetic Retail Manager to lead the team and take the store forward.

Key Responsibilities
•	Oversee the day-to-day running of the store from open to close, keeping displays, demonstration devices and point-of-sale material presentation-ready at all times.
•	Build and lead a capable, motivated team by recruiting and inducting new staff, preparing rosters, coaching product knowledge and sales technique, and supervising day-to-day performance.
•	Lead from the shop floor by selling the latest handsets, accessories, mobile broadband, NBN devices and Vodafone plans, matching each customer with the option that best suits their needs and showing them how to set up and get the most from their new device.
•	Set and model the store's customer service standards, and step in to resolve escalated enquiries, warranty and repair bookings and complaints through to a positive outcome.
•	Shape the store's product range and merchandising mix across smartphones, accessories and connectivity devices, and determine the right stock holdings ahead of new releases and peak trading periods.
•	Drive local promotional activity, including in-store campaigns, shopping centre displays and new device launch events, to lift foot traffic and build the Mo's Mobiles name across the Greater Springfield community.
•	Develop and apply the store's buying and promotional plans in line with Vodafone partner guidelines, and review pricing on handsets and accessories so the store stays competitive while protecting margin.
•	Prepare and manage the store budget, set weekly and monthly sales targets, and track results against revenue and cost plans, acting early when performance drifts.
•	Keep accurate records of stock movements and financial transactions, including daily takings, banking and end-of-day reconciliation, and report trading results to head office.
•	Conduct regular stocktakes and manage shrinkage and loss prevention, including the secure handling of high-value devices and SIM stock.
•	Maintain a safe store for staff and customers by applying workplace health and safety requirements, completing routine safety checks and addressing hazards promptly.
•	Follow telecommunications-specific processes with care, including customer identification checks on new connections and the protection of customer information and privacy.
•	Work closely with head office and Vodafone on stock allocations, new device launches and promotional roll-outs, and share local market insights and customer feedback.

Qualifications and Experience
•	A qualification at AQF Associate Degree, Advanced Diploma or Diploma level (essential).
•	At least one year of relevant experience in a retail environment, ideally in a supervisory or management capacity. Experience in telecommunications or consumer electronics retail will be highly regarded.

Personal Attributes
•	A natural people leader who motivates the team, coaches in the moment and leads by example.
•	Customer-first in outlook, with the patience and warmth to explain technology clearly to customers of every age and comfort level.
•	Results-driven, with sound commercial judgement and a healthy competitive streak.
•	Organised and dependable, with close attention to detail across cash handling, stock and paperwork.
•	A clear and confident communicator with strong interpersonal skills.
•	Curious about technology and quick to master new devices, plans and systems.
•	A high standard of personal integrity, comfortable being accountable for takings and high-value stock.
•	Calm and adaptable during busy trade, new device launches and seasonal peaks.

What We Offer
•	A salary of $75,000 to $85,000 per annum plus superannuation, commensurate with skills and experience.
•	The stability of a permanent, full-time role typically 38 hours per week with an established national retailer.

How to Apply
If you are ready to lead a store where technology meets community, we would love to hear from you. Please apply with your current resume and a short cover letter outlining your retail leadership experience. Only shortlisted applicants will be contacted.

Come and join our team at Southern and experience all our District has to offer!

At Southern NSW Local Health District (Southern) we are working to help our communities lead healthy lives. Our mission is that all people across our diverse societies have timely access to the right healthcare in the right setting to maximise their health, wellbeing and independence.

Southern covers a large area of the state, from Goulburn and Crookwell to the Victorian border, and surrounds the ACT on three sides. A total of 44 537sq kms, extending from the pristine beaches of the NSW South Coast, the farmlands of the Southern Tablelands, across the picturesque Monaro and spectacular Snowy Mountings of the Great Dividing Range. 

We are home to five large Aboriginal nations - the Gundungurra, Ngambri, Ngunnawal, Ngarigo and Yuin people. Southern NSWLHD comprises of four Networks - Tablelands is centred around Goulburn, Monaro centred around Queanbeyan and Cooma, the Coastal Network located in the far south-east corner of NSW, and the Integrated Care Network.

Where you'll be working - Queanbeyan

An exciting opportunity has arisen for an experienced and suitably qualified FACEM to lead the emergency department team at Queanbeyan District Hospital.

Queanbeyan Hospital and Health Service is part of the Monaro Network. It has 29 inpatient beds and offers emergency medicine; surgery (orthopaedics, gastroenterology, gynaecology, general surgery and obstetrics); inpatient services including close observation, maternity, surgical and medical beds; renal dialysis; pathology collection; pharmacy; and medical imaging (x-ray, CT and ultrasound).

The Queanbeyan ED sees approximately 27000 presentations per year. It has a relatively low admission ratter of 6% and a transfer rate of 5-6% due to it being bypassed for STEMI, Stroke, Trauma. 23% of presentations are children under 16 with 25% of them being under 3 years of age. 7.8% of presentations are indigenous.

The ED is currently staffed with senior doctors; there are plans to introduce a junior doctor for 2 shifts a day on weekdays only for 2027.

There has been a recent recruitment drive for emergency specialists and by 2027 we should have a total of 4FTE Staff specialist FACEMs.

There is significant opportunity to attain core accreditation with ACEM for registrar training.

There are good collegial relationships with the other EDs in Southern. As such many of the Emergency specialists that work in Queanbeyan will also provide services in Cooma, South East regional Hospital and Goulburn Base hospital. This will allow those hospitals to apply for and attain accreditation for blended supervision of ACEM trainees during their mandatory rural term starting in 2027

In terms of collegial relationships there are excellent relationships with the rural generalist inpatient VMOs many of which also do shifts in the ED. There is no conflict regarding admissions to the hospital as all consultations are senior doctor to senior doctor.

The Queanbeyan ED has excellent relationships with TCH ED and many of our doctors' work in both sites

It is an exciting time to be a director at Queanbeyan hospital. What it needs now is an excellent training program and accreditation. If your passion is to provide better healthcare to a whole district rather than one-on-one on the floor, then this is the position for you.

The split in work is 20-25 hours a week managerial-leadership and the remainder of the FTE clinical

This position would be excellent for those candidates who have a passion for providing the highest standard of training and clinical care. It would also be an excellent job for those who look to spreading their wings in learning to be a leader. Mentoring for the right candidate would be available

present. Processes are in place to support workers that need to keep facial hair due to religious observance 
requirements and- or health conditions.

Emergency Medicine Trainee - Stage 1
Lismore Base Hospital & Richmond Network

An exciting opportunity is available at Lismore Base Hospital for an Emergency Medicine Trainee (Stage 1) for the 2027 Clinical Year, commencing 1 February 2027, at the Lismore Base Hospital and its peripheral sites (Ballina and Casino Hospitals). The successful applicants will gain valuable experience in our hospital in the beautiful Northern NSW LHD - Richmond Network, working under the guidance of highly experienced senior clinicians as part of the Australasian College of Emergency Medicine's (ACEM) training program.

Accreditation: Lismore Base Hospital (Richmond Network) is accredited for 36 months of training as a Trainee Stage 1-3, 6 months as Trainee Stage 4 (Lismore ED), and 3 months as Trainee Stage 4 (non-ED Medical Education).

Education: We offer weekly paid protected education sessions facilitated by Dr Martin Duffy (ACEM Educator of the Year 2021), including simulation, clinical skills, case reviews, radiology, and paediatrics. Additional structured programs are offered to trainees preparing for ACEM primary and fellowship exams. LBH also supports trainees with funding external education activities including Alfred Health Emergency Procedures Course and ACEM Diploma of Pre Hospital and Retrieval Medicine. 

Where you'll be working
Lismore Base Hospital (LBH) is the recognised Trauma Centre for the North Coast Region and is linked with the local helicopter retrieval service. The Lismore Base Hospital (LBH) Emergency Department (ED) sees over 41,000 adult and paediatric presentations per year and is a regional trauma centre. The hospital is an acute referral hospital of 280 beds on the Far North Coast of NSW, serving a population of approximately 170,000 people on the Far North Coast of NSW and has a busy Emergency Department (55 beds-treatment spaces), 12 bed ICU and 6 bed Coronary Care Unit.

LBH is an affiliated teaching hospital for medical students from the University of Sydney, University of Wollongong, University of Western Sydney, University of Newcastle, Bond University, University of Queensland and Griffith University. The hospital has a strong commitment to teaching and support for its Junior Medical Officers.

Our region encompasses World Heritage listed rainforests and the pristine beaches of Evans Head, Ballina, Lennox Head and Byron Bay. This area is blessed by year-round sun, a tropical climate and a short winter. From lush hinterland villages, to Mount Warning, national parks, and sparkling beaches, the region is full of natural wonders and vibrant destinations all within a short drive from Lismore.

What you'll be doing
 

The primary purpose of a Trainee - Stage 1 in Emergency Medicine is to provide safe and high-quality care, assess and manage, under supervision, patients presenting to the Emergency Department (ED) and admitted to inpatient wards when rotating to inpatient specialities. The trainee needs to be aware of their limitations and work in a collegiate and collaborate manner. 
 
Decision making and supervision will be at the appropriate level according to the trainee's skills, knowledge and experience. The medical officer will be expected to adopt a progressively more independent approach to patient management according to their experience, under the guidance of and at the discretion of the appropriate Attending Medical Officer (AMO). All patients managed within the hospitals of the health service are under the direct care of a specialist medical practitioner. All decisions regarding their care are to be clearly communicated with the specialist responsible for that care. 
 
The position supports meeting the requirements for Stage 1 training with the Australasian College for Emergency Medicine (ACEM).

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 

 

Qualifications and experience commensurate with the Essential Requirements for the role.

Demonstrated ability to work independently in a supervised environment.

Demonstrated ability to work effectively as part of a multi-disciplinary team with an understanding of the roles of the doctor and other members of the healthcare team.

Demonstrated high level written and verbal communication skills and ability to communicate effectively and respectfully with patients, family members and other members of the health care team.

Demonstrated good organisational and time management skills and ability to manage competing priorities in a complex environment.

Demonstrated commitment to quality improvement, patient safety and risk management.

Evidence of continuing professional development and commitment to self-education.
